# noise.js

Seeded pixel noise for the noise guaranteed brand, copied unchanged from
noiseguaranteed.github.io (`js/noise.js`, branch `main`, commit `5fb5b04`). GPL-3.0, as that repo.

It's kept here, not loaded from the site, so Gaze Harp works offline and from `file://`.
To update it, copy the file again and change the commit above. The brand rules are in that repo's `BRAND.md`.
